title: Marguerite and the Ledger
author: Juniper Zhou
blurb: Ivo Hartwell, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
